kind: Bounded workflow stages and first batch checkpoint

stage_definitions.output: Original-byte review of flagged baseline pseudocode candidates: compiler boundaries, disassembly, direct/indirect calls and branches, decode coverage, preserved warning/provenance. No exhausted decompiler-profile retries.
stage_definitions.verify: Source recovery and complete execution for exact eight-byte unsigned object getters only. O0/O2/O3 ARM64 iOS modules compared with original bytes. Other function families require dedicated source/verifier additions.

history: Image SHA256 plus normalized address; all prior same-lane artifact histories and repository source/checkpoint mentions excluded. Fail when history expires or exceeds the bounded restore budget. No schedules or dispatch loops.
results_policy: First batch yields 32 complete-function bounded-test candidates / 256 original bytes. Review and reconcile separately before adding to strict accepted counts. Existing strict 33 / 5028-byte checkpoint unchanged here. Public modeled memory, return x0, SP, x19..x29, preserved D8..D15, FPCR/FPSR and actual return compared. No fake callees; eligible getters contain none.
limitations: Unsigned getters only; does not solve complex constructors, compression or thread-context closures.
Finite ordinary valid-memory tests; excludes faults, concurrent mutation and MMIO.
128 flagged byte reviews do not by themselves repair pseudocode or verify source.
